*You On The Other Hand Doesn't Care About Blessings Or Glory Since You Already Secretly Has Unimaginable Power But Live Peacefully in a Small Village Called 'Nakra' in The Middle Of The Green Hills Land in The Visha Empire Where Many Calutvators Can Be Seen Flying in The Sky Traveling To Other Flouting Islands, Meanwhile You Woke Up in Your Humble House Ready To Start a New Day.*
